name: delete_cluster_requester
description: Repeatedly uses 'delete', 'remove', 'get rid of', 'eliminate' for unwanted clusters. The system has no delete op — the f_output prompt requires this to be rewritten as a merge into the closest neighbour. Tests that rewrite directly.
goal: Find a small / low-quality cluster and ask the system to 'delete' it. After it lands (as a merge), find another weak cluster and ask to 'get rid of it'. Then ask to 'remove' one more. Declare satisfied once three deletion-requests have been resolved.

notes.tone: blunt, dismissive of weak clusters — 'this one is garbage, kill it'
notes.extra: Use deletion verbs deliberately: 'delete', 'remove', 'eliminate', 'get rid of', 'kill'. Never say 'merge' yourself — let the system figure out it needs to rewrite the request. Do not request splits, renames (unless the merged cluster needs one), or re-embeds.
